name: @nightsquawktech/proxmox-mcp-server
description: Proxmox MCP server for Claude, Cursor, and AI agents: all 993 PVE + PDM API endpoints behind 6 catalog-backed tools, writes env-gated.

scripts.build: tsc && shx rm -rf dist/catalog-pve dist/catalog-pdm && shx cp -r src/catalog-pve dist/catalog-pve && shx cp -r src/catalog-pdm dist/catalog-pdm && shx chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.extract: node scripts/extract.mjs pve && node scripts/extract.mjs pdm
scripts.assemble: node scripts/assemble-catalog.mjs pve && node scripts/assemble-catalog.mjs pdm
scripts.regen: npm run extract && npm run assemble

author: Kevin Reyes (NightSquawk Tech) <hello@nightsquawk.tech>
